svg.aria-label: Toolbox as a stepped tower at night, one floor per layer, each floor building on the ones below. intelligence tier: agents: Claude Code, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI; interfaces: MCP, ACP, A2A, Agent Skills; automation: n8n, Hermes Kanban, Playwright. models tier: media: ComfyUI, Whisper, text-to-speech, FFmpeg; inference: Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio; training: Unsloth, PyTorch, Hugging Face. services tier: code: Python, uv, Node.js, TypeScript, PHP, Git; web: nginx, Apache, PHP-FPM; databases: Qdrant, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, SQLite. infrastructure tier: runtime: Docker, Docker Compose, Portainer, QEMU, VirtualBox; network: WireGuard, Tailscale, SSH, Little Snitch; storage: LVM, Samba, rsync; shell: Bash, PowerShell, cmd, tmux; system: Debian, Ubuntu, Red Hat, CentOS, Windows, Windows Server.
